en:
CTE Workcell

The VEX CTE Workcell includes specialized devices used to simulate automated material handling and industrial control systems. These devices provide precise motion control and sensing within the VEX CTE Workcell environment.

Below is a list of available CTE Workcell devices:

  • Arm - A 6-Axis robotic arm that provides precise positioning and movement control for pick-and-place operations and complex manipulations.
  • Object Sensor - Detects the presence and properties of objects within the workcell environment for automated sorting and handling.
  • Pneumatics - Controls pneumatic solenoids for air-powered actuators and mechanisms in the workcell.
  • Signal Tower - A visual indicator system with multiple colored LEDs and button input for status monitoring and user interaction.
zh:
CTE 工作站

VEX CTE Workcell 包括用于模拟自动化物料搬运和工业控制系统的专用设备。这些设备在 VEX CTE Workcell 环境中提供精确的运动控制和传感。

以下是可用 CTE Workcell 设备的列表：

  • 手臂- 一款 6 轴机械臂，可为拾放操作和复杂操作提供精确定位和运动控制。
  • 物体传感器- 检测工作单元环境中物体的存在和属性，以进行自动分类和处理。
  • 气动装置- 控制工作单元中气动执行器和机构的气动电磁阀。
  • 信号塔- 视觉指示器系统，具有多种彩色 LED 和按钮输入，用于状态监控和用户交互。
